title: Straw Men #4 Innovation All-American Comics 1990 Dressing Room Mirror Horror
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Straw Men #4 (1990), Innovation / All-American Comics. Cover shows a man at a dressing-room mirror with a back-mounted device. Original $1.95 cover price ($2.50 in Canada).

Back cover: "What the Critics Say About Straw Men" review from Amazing Heroes #171.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
